main.description:
Proxied XRPC request through an arbiter's policy.

The caller authenticates via serviceAuth (aud = arbiter-server DID,
lxm = town.muni.arbiter.proxy). The body specifies the arbiter DID to act
on behalf of, the target DID#service to reach, and the inner XRPC
request (method, nsid, parameters, body) to evaluate. The server drives
the arbiter's Rego policy and proxies the inner request to the target
authenticated as the stewarded account.

The `nsid` here is the *inner* request NSID, distinct from this
procedure's own NSID.

This lexicon documents the request body shared by the whole
`*.arbiter.proxy` NSID family: the arbiter also serves any
`<scope>.arbiter.proxy` endpoint (e.g.
`community.lexicon.authCalendar.arbiter.proxy`) with this same body
schema. Apps reach those endpoints by OAuthing into the user's PDS with
the `rpc:<scope>.arbiter.proxy` scope and sending
`atproto-proxy: <arbiter DID>#arbiter`; the scope (the NSID with the
`.arbiter.proxy` suffix stripped) must be exactly one of the account's
trusted scopes (`town.muni.arbiter.config/self`) before the policy
pipeline runs. This procedure's own NSID remains the owner/manager path.

arbiterDid.description: The stewarded account's DID to act on behalf of.

target.description: The destination DID#service for the proxied request (e.g. did:plc:xyz#atproto_pds).

method.description: HTTP method for the inner XRPC request (GET, POST, etc).

parameters.description: Optional query parameters for the inner request.

body.description: Optional body for the inner request. A JSON value is proxied as JSON; the AT Protocol binary marker { "$bytes": <base64> } proxies raw bytes (e.g. a blob upload).

encoding.description: Optional content-type (encoding) for the inner request body (e.g. image/png). Defaults to application/json.

schema.description: The body of the inner XRPC response.

errors.name: ErrPermissionDenied
errors.description: The requesting user is not allowed to proxy through this arbiter.
